page_title: JUV 2-1 CAG | Juventus v Cagliari 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Marco Piccinini has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
88' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) replacing Jakub Jankto.
88' It's time for a substitution. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Juventus) comes on in place of Andrea Cambiaso.
87' The foul by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Marco Piccinini.
84' A dangerous towering header by Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
84' Filip Kostic (Juventus) takes the corner.
82' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His almost perfect header hits the left post and ricochets away off it.
82' Filip Kostic (Juventus) is yellow-carded.
81' Substitution. Federico Chiesa did his best and is replaced by Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus).

75' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header inside the right post. 2:1.
75' Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
74' The resulting set piece from Juventus is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
72' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Juventus players have a reason to celebrate!
71' Substitution. Zito Luvumbo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari).
71' The Juventus players halt their celebrations as referee Marco Piccinini makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
70' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.

70' 2 - 0 The ball finds its way to Daniele Rugani (Juventus) after a confusing situation inside the goalmouth. He finds some space and easily knocks the ball in with his body and alters the score to 2:0.
70' The ball is out of play. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner.
69' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) swings in a cross from the corner, but Simone Scuffet reads it well and gathers the ball.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) is coming onto the pitch as Nicolas Viola cannot continue after picking up an injury.
66' Here is a change. Fabio Miretti is going off and Massimiliano Allegri gives the last tactical orders to Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Moise Kean departs the field of play to be replaced by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus).
65' 47:53 – the latest ball possession ratio. We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 12:8.
60' 1 - 0 Bremer (Juventus) scores from a quite difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the left post. Excellent finish.
57' Weston McKennie (Juventus) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
55' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Filip Kostic (Juventus) takes it short.
54' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the left post.
54' Filip Kostic (Juventus) drives a shot towards the bottom left corner from inside the box, but Simone Scuffet leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
49' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
48' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
46' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Claudio Ranieri gives a chance to Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) and Andrea Petagna is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' Marco Piccinini has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' Juventus fail to score from a corner as Simone Scuffet (Cagliari) leaps to collect the ball.
44' Federico Gatti (Juventus) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
43' Weston McKennie (Juventus) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but his shot missed the target close to the right post.
38' Juventus can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
36' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
29' A cross from a corner kick by Juventus is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
24' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
24' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) will take a corner kick.
24' The linesman makes the right call and Cagliari will have a corner.
20' Juventus take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
18' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
12' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
8' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
4' The corner from Federico Chiesa (Juventus) is hurriedly cleared.
3' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
3' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Juventus will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Marco Piccinini.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
